certificates.note: Search over signed permutations only, not all GL(5,Z). Failure is inconclusive. Root removal is safe only while retaining the anchor's complete lattice-descendant obligation.

conditional_scaling_original_and_indices.note: No root reduction or cross-record caching. Scenario b is additional nodes per nonreflexive start, not an observed completed-search mean. Other indices, CWS and global maximality costs excluded.

lattice_tree.note: All 2,3-smooth indices through cap only; other primes are not covered. Kernel also evaluates some redundant/over-cap candidates; unique counts describe a scheduler that deduplicates before hull work.

limitations: Metadata counts are not independent validation of every record or deduplication.
Only representative WS records and bounded search obligations were tested.
Elapsed native kernel time is used as single-worker cost, not a hardware CPU counter.
Bootstrap intervals account for 64 sampled clusters, not unseen extreme tails.
No complete lattice enumeration or complete 5D classification was performed.
CWS timing is not inferred from WS timing.
Global maximality probes use reflexive WS roots, not post-pruning leaf candidates.

maximality.note: Completed-only times are selection-biased. All unresolved final cases censored at five seconds. Function counters are from separate instrumented repeats.

random_recursive_probes.note: Censored node counts are lower bounds, never completed-search estimates.

sampling: 64 independent uniform record draws per dataset identify PPS row-group clusters; three additional uniform records per selected cluster give 256 random probes per dataset. Within-cluster observations are correlated. Extrema/bin probes are biased and must not enter population means. Seed 20261104, extension seed 20261105.
warmup: Native repetition zero excluded; medians of next three.
